difficultyRationale: Tests the producer side of upper-bounded wildcards and why they do not safely accept arbitrary Number values.
prompt: Given `List<? extends Number> values`, which operation is guaranteed to be type-safe and compile?
explanation: The wildcard says the list contains elements of some unknown subtype of Number. Reading an element as Number is safe. Adding a specific Number subtype is not generally safe because the actual element type might be a different subtype.

options.explanation: Whatever the captured subtype is, every element is a Number.
The captured element type might not be Integer, so adding an Integer is not generally allowed.
The captured element type might not be Double.
The captured element type might be some other Number subtype.

references.title: JLS 4.5.1 Type Arguments of Parameterized Types
